title: Growth plates are the zones where bones lengthen as a child grows
summary: NIAMS says bones lengthen at growth plates, special zones that grow as a child grows taller.
body: The NIAMS bones page says that as a person grows older and grows taller, the bones grow too. It calls the special zones that grow along growth plates. The page also says bone tissue keeps changing, with old tissue broken down and new tissue made. This card is the growth-plate sentence. It does not give a height, and it does not say when the plates end, because that page does not print an ending age.

sources.title: Health Lesson: Learning About Bones
sources.author: National Institute of Arthritis and Musculoskeletal and Skin Diseases
sources.note: US government page, public domain. Last Updated June 2025. Supports growth plates as special zones of bones that grow with the child, in the How do bones grow section.
